strategies.name: Baseline Sequential All-Reduce Stages
strategies.desc: Eight sequential all_reduce calls with interleaved local bidiagonal coupling (forward) and uncoupling (backward) transformations on the full W*S tensor. Total 8 dispatches (one all_reduce per stage). Straightforward translation of the problem statement with no fusion or overlap, trading simplicity for maximum dispatch count.

strategies.name: Fused Local Transform Batching
strategies.desc: Group consecutive coupling/uncoupling operations into single vectorized kernels before each all_reduce, reducing local-op dispatch overhead. Still 8 all_reduce dispatches but compresses all rank-indexed shard transformations into 2-3 fused local operations per stage (forward coupling, backward uncoupling, normalization). Improves compute efficiency without changing communication pattern.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc: Replace each all_reduce with reduce_scatter (producing local shard) followed by all_gather to reconstruct full tensor. Total 16 dispatches (2 per stage). Enables potential bandwidth optimization on hardware where RS+AG outperforms AR for large payloads, and allows local transforms to operate on smaller intermediate shards between collective phases.

strategies.name: Pipelined Overlapped Communication-Computation
strategies.desc: Split the W*S tensor into chunks and pipeline all_reduce operations with local transformations using async dispatch where available. Issue next stage's all_reduce while current stage's coupling/uncoupling executes on already-reduced data. Maintains 8 logical all_reduce stages but overlaps compute with communication latency, trading code complexity for wall-clock time reduction.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level All-Reduce
strategies.desc:
Exploit multi-node topology (7 nodes × 32 ranks/node at world_size=224) by structuring each all_reduce as intra-node reduction + inter-node reduction + intra-node broadcast. Total 24 dispatches (3 per stage: node-local AR, cross-node AR on reduced data, node-local broadcast). Optimizes for NVLink intra-node bandwidth vs. slower inter-node links, reducing cross-node payload by factor of 32.
